newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai expands China's premier duty-free zone.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai expands China's premier duty-free zone.

text.p: Shanghai has expanded the Waigaoqiao Free Trade Development Zone, the largest duty-free zone in China, to 6.4 square km from 5.5 square km, the Business News said on Thursday.

The newspaper said the move was taken to accommodate the growing number of foreign firms investing in the free-trade zone, which now hosts more than 2,900 overseas companies compared with 1,380 at the end of the 1994.
In the first five months of this year, the zone registered a gross domestic product (GDP) of 1.67 billion yuan, an increase of 23.7 percent from the same period last year, the newspaper said.
